Mr Brooks.zh: Brooks 先生 · 图书馆馆长

episodes.title: The Other Side
episodes.scene_zh: 你在纽约落地。Jake 举着一块写错了你名字的牌子在机场等你。

lines.en: Lin! Welcome to New York! Sorry about the sign. My assistant spelled it with two Ns.
lines.zh: 林！欢迎来纽约！牌子的事抱歉，我助理多写了一个 N。

lines.en: Don't worry. After eight hours on a plane, I'm just happy someone came to meet me.
lines.zh: 没关系。坐了八个小时飞机，有人来接我就很开心了。

lines.en: Of course! Let's grab your bags. The car's waiting outside, and traffic's going to be brutal.
lines.zh: 当然！拿上行李吧。车在外面等，路上肯定堵得要命。

lines.en: Is it far to the flat? Sorry, the apartment. I'll have to start speaking American now.
lines.zh: 到公寓远吗？抱歉，是 apartment。我现在得开始说美式英语了。

lines.en: Ha! About an hour. You're in Brooklyn, third floor, no elevator. I hope you packed light.
lines.zh: 哈！一个小时左右。你住布鲁克林，三楼，没电梯。希望你行李不多。

lines.en: Two suitcases and a notebook. The notebook is the important one.
lines.zh: 两个箱子和一本笔记本。笔记本最重要。

lines.en: Sophie's notebook? She told me about that. 'For the next person', right?
lines.zh: Sophie 那本？她跟我说过。“给下一个人”，对吧？

lines.en: That's right. I'm supposed to find someone who needs it more than I do.
lines.zh: 对。我应该找到一个比我更需要它的人。

lines.en: Well, this city has eight million people. Somebody's bound to need it.
lines.zh: 嗯，这座城市有八百万人，总会有人需要的。

lines.en: No pressure, then. What's the plan for tomorrow?
lines.zh: 那就没压力了。明天什么安排？

lines.en: Team meeting at nine. Dana, our creative director, wants to touch base before we kick things off.
lines.zh: 九点开团队会。我们的创意总监 Dana 想在项目启动前先碰个头。

lines.en: Touch base. Is that good or bad?
lines.zh: Touch base？这是好事还是坏事？

lines.en: It just means a quick chat. Trust me, you'll hear a lot of phrases like that.
lines.zh: 就是简单聊聊。相信我，这种说法你会听到很多。

choice.q_zh: 纽约有八百万人，你问 Jake：

lines.en: How will I know when I've found the right person?
lines.zh: 我怎么知道找对人了？

lines.en: Sophie said you'd just know. Very helpful, Sophie.
lines.zh: Sophie 说你到时候自然就知道。真是谢谢 Sophie 了。

lines.en: Eight million people, and you're the only one I know.
lines.zh: 八百万人，我只认识你一个。

lines.en: Then start talking to strangers. You're good at that.
lines.zh: 那就去跟陌生人说话。你最擅长这个。

lines.en: Look out of the window. We're crossing the bridge now.
lines.zh: 看窗外，我们正在过桥。

lines.en: Oh my goodness. It looks exactly like the films.
lines.zh: 天哪，跟电影里一模一样。

lines.en: Everyone says that. Then they live here for a month and start complaining about the subway.
lines.zh: 人人都这么说。住一个月就开始抱怨地铁了。

lines.en: I'll try to stay amazed for at least two months.
lines.zh: 我争取至少惊叹两个月。

lines.en: That's the spirit. Welcome to Brooklyn.
lines.zh: 这就对了。欢迎来到布鲁克林。

quiz.q: 机场的接机牌出了什么问题？
options: 写成了 Jake 的名字

quiz.q: 林住在哪里？
options: 布鲁克林三楼，没有电梯

quiz.q: “touch base” 在这里是什么意思？

episodes.next_zh: 第二天一早就要去公司开会。会上的英语，你一半都没听懂……

episodes.title: Touch Base
episodes.scene_zh: 公司第一天。Dana 的会议节奏很快，满是你在伦敦从没听过的说法。

lines.en: Morning, everyone. Let's make this quick. Lin, welcome aboard. We're thrilled to have you.
lines.zh: 大家早。我们快点开。林，欢迎加入，很高兴你来。

lines.en: Thank you. I'm really glad to be here.
lines.zh: 谢谢，我真的很高兴来到这里。

lines.en: So, the big picture. We've got three new clients this quarter, and our bandwidth is pretty limited.
lines.zh: 先说大局。这个季度有三个新客户，我们的人手很紧。

lines.en: Ballpark, how many hours are we talking for the first project?
lines.zh: 大概估一下，第一个项目要多少小时？

lines.en: Ballpark? Two hundred. But let's circle back on that once we've seen the brief.
lines.zh: 大概两百小时。不过看完需求说明再回头细谈。

lines.en: Sorry, can I check something? When you say bandwidth, you mean time, not internet?
lines.zh: 抱歉，我能确认一下吗？你说 bandwidth，是指时间，不是网速？

lines.en: Ha, yeah. Time and energy. Don't worry, I had to learn all this too. I'm from Ohio.
lines.zh: 哈，对。指时间和精力。别担心，这些我也是学来的。我是俄亥俄来的。

lines.en: Good question, Lin. Always ask. I'd much rather you ask than guess.
lines.zh: 问得好，林。随时问。我宁可你问，也不要你猜。

lines.en: In that case, what does 'circle back' mean? It sounds like we're going around in circles.
lines.zh: 那我再问一个，circle back 是什么意思？听起来像是在原地打转。

lines.en: It means we'll come back to it later. Although, honestly, sometimes we do go around in circles.
lines.zh: 意思是晚点再回来讨论。不过说实话，有时候我们确实在打转。

lines.en: Welcome to corporate America. Want me to make you a cheat sheet?
lines.zh: 欢迎来到美国职场。要不要我给你做张小抄？

lines.en: Yes, please. I'll take any help I can get.
lines.zh: 好啊，拜托了。有帮助我都要。

lines.en: In London, we'd say "let's park that for now".
lines.zh: 在伦敦我们会说“这个先放一放”。

lines.en: Park it? I love that. I'm stealing it.
lines.zh: Park it？我喜欢，归我了。

lines.en: Are there any other phrases I should know before lunch?
lines.zh: 午饭前还有什么说法我该知道的吗？

lines.en: "Low-hanging fruit." The easy wins. Start with those.
lines.zh: “低垂的果子”，就是容易拿下的。先从这些做起。

lines.en: Here's your cheat sheet. Want me to read it out?
lines.zh: 你的小抄。要我念一遍吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Slowly.
lines.zh: 好，慢一点。

lines.en: Touch base: a quick chat. Circle back: later. Bandwidth: time. Ballpark: a rough number.
lines.zh: touch base：简单聊聊。circle back：回头再说。bandwidth：时间精力。ballpark：大概的数。

lines.en: And "let's take this offline" means "not in front of everyone".
lines.zh: 还有 let's take this offline，意思是“别当着大家的面说”。

lines.en: This is gold. Can I take this offline and study it?
lines.zh: 这太有用了。我能把它“线下”带回去研究吗？

lines.en: Ha! You're a fast learner.
lines.zh: 哈！你学得真快。

quiz.q: Dana 说的 bandwidth 指什么？
Dana 希望林遇到不懂的时候怎么做？
Marcus 主动提出帮林做什么？

episodes.next_zh: 晚上回到公寓，房东 Alvarez 太太已经在楼梯口等着你了。

episodes.title: The Landlady
episodes.scene_zh: 你拎着购物袋爬上三楼。Alvarez 太太在楼梯口等你，好像有话要说。

lines.en: There you are! You must be Lin. I'm Rosa Alvarez. I live on the first floor.
lines.zh: 你回来了！你一定是林吧。我是 Rosa Alvarez，住一楼。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Mrs Alvarez. Is everything all right?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识您，Alvarez 太太。一切都好吗？

lines.en: Oh, everything's fine. I just wanted to warn you about the radiator. It makes a terrible noise at night.
lines.zh: 哦，都好。我只是想提醒你暖气片的事，它晚上响得厉害。

lines.en: I did hear something last night. I thought someone was hitting the pipes with a hammer.
lines.zh: 我昨晚确实听到了动静，还以为有人拿锤子敲水管。

lines.en: That's just New York. The super is coming on Tuesday to take a look.
lines.zh: 那就是纽约特色。管理员周二会来看看。

lines.en: The super? Is that like a manager?
lines.zh: Super？是类似物业经理吗？

lines.en: The superintendent. He fixes things, takes out the trash, and complains about everybody.
lines.zh: 就是 superintendent。他修东西、倒垃圾，还爱抱怨所有人。

lines.en: We'd call that a caretaker in London. Without the complaining, usually.
lines.zh: 在伦敦我们叫 caretaker。一般不抱怨。

lines.en: Ha! You're funny. Where are you from originally?
lines.zh: 哈！你真有意思。你原来是哪里人？

lines.en: China, but I lived in London for almost two years before this.
lines.zh: 中国，不过来这儿之前在伦敦住了将近两年。

lines.en: My parents came from Puerto Rico. When they arrived, they didn't speak a word of English. Now look at me, I never stop talking.
lines.zh: 我父母是从波多黎各来的。刚来的时候一句英语都不会。现在看看我，一开口就停不下来。

lines.en: That gives me hope. If you ever need anything, I'm on the third floor.
lines.zh: 这让我有信心了。您要是需要帮忙，我就在三楼。

lines.en: I know, honey. I'm the landlady. Now go and eat something, you look exhausted.
lines.zh: 我知道，亲爱的，我是房东。快去吃点东西吧，你看起来累坏了。

choice.q_zh: 暖气要到周二才修，你问：

lines.en: Tuesday? Is there anything I can do until then?
lines.zh: 周二？那之前我能做点什么吗？

lines.en: Earplugs, honey. The best two dollars you'll ever spend.
lines.zh: 耳塞，亲爱的。你花过最值的两块钱。

lines.en: Does it happen every winter?
lines.zh: 每年冬天都这样吗？

lines.en: Every winter for thirty years. I've given it a name. Big Frank.
lines.zh: 三十年来每个冬天都这样。我给它起了个名字，叫大弗兰克。

lines.en: I made too much arroz con pollo. Chicken and rice. Take some.
lines.zh: 我做多了鸡肉饭，拿点去吃。

lines.en: This smells incredible. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 闻着太香了。太谢谢您了。

lines.en: My mother taught me. She said food is the first language everybody understands.
lines.zh: 我妈妈教的。她说，食物是每个人都听得懂的第一种语言。

lines.en: A friend in Edinburgh says almost exactly the same thing.
lines.zh: 爱丁堡有个朋友几乎说过一模一样的话。

lines.en: Then she's a smart woman. Bring the bowl back when you're done.
lines.zh: 那她很聪明。吃完把碗还回来。

quiz.q: Alvarez 太太想提醒林什么？
纽约的 super 是什么人？
options: 大楼管理员，负责维修和倒垃圾

quiz.q: Alvarez 太太的父母刚到美国时英语怎么样？

episodes.next_zh: 周末，Jake 和 Marcus 约你去吃早午餐。账单来的时候，你不知道该给多少小费。

episodes.title: Brunch
episodes.scene_zh: 周日上午，Jake 和 Marcus 带你去布鲁克林一家很火的早午餐店。

lines.en: Okay, this place has the best pancakes in Brooklyn. Don't let the line scare you.
lines.zh: 好，这家的松饼是布鲁克林最好的。别被排队吓到。

lines.en: In London, a queue this long would be for a concert, not breakfast.
lines.zh: 在伦敦，排这么长的队应该是买演唱会门票，不是吃早饭。

lines.en: Brunch, Lin. In New York, brunch is basically a religion.
lines.zh: 是早午餐，林。在纽约，早午餐差不多算是一种信仰。

lines.en: I'll have the eggs, please. Scrambled. And a coffee.
lines.zh: 我要鸡蛋，炒蛋。再来一杯咖啡。

lines.en: Two eggs over easy, bacon, and a stack of pancakes. And keep the coffee coming.
lines.zh: 两个单面嫩煎蛋、培根、一叠松饼。咖啡给我续着。

lines.en: Over easy? I'm going to add that to the cheat sheet.
lines.zh: Over easy？我要把这个加进小抄里。

lines.en: So, one week in. How's the Big Apple treating you?
lines.zh: 来了一周了，纽约对你怎么样？

lines.en: Honestly? Everyone asks how I am, but nobody waits for the answer. It took me a few days to realise it's just hello.
lines.zh: 说实话？每个人都问我好不好，但没人等我回答。我过了好几天才明白，那其实就是打招呼。

lines.en: That's the most New York thing I've ever heard. Okay, here's the check.
lines.zh: 这是我听过最纽约的事了。好，账单来了。

lines.en: How much should I leave? In London, I'd just round it up a little.
lines.zh: 我该给多少？在伦敦我就把零头凑整一下。

lines.en: Here it's usually twenty percent. The servers depend on tips. Their basic pay is really low.
lines.zh: 这里一般给百分之二十。服务员靠小费生活，他们的底薪很低。

lines.en: Twenty percent. Okay. I think I just learned more about America than in a whole week at work.
lines.zh: 百分之二十，好。我觉得这顿饭让我对美国的了解，比上一整周班还多。

options.label_zh: 问 over easy 是什么

lines.en: What does "over easy" actually mean?
lines.zh: over easy 到底是什么意思？

lines.en: Fried on both sides, but the yolk's still runny. Trust me.
lines.zh: 两面煎，但蛋黄还是流心的。相信我。

lines.en: Actually, can I have what he's having?
lines.zh: 要不我点跟他一样的吧？

lines.en: Bold move. You won't regret it.
lines.zh: 有胆量。你不会后悔的。

lines.en: Emma, look at the size of these pancakes. That's one portion.
lines.zh: Emma，看这松饼有多大。这只是一份。

lines.en: That's not breakfast, Lin. That's a building.
lines.zh: 林，那不是早饭，是一栋楼。

lines.en: And I tipped twenty percent. I feel very American.
lines.zh: 我还付了百分之二十的小费。我觉得自己很美国了。

lines.en: Don't come back with an accent. I'm warning you.
lines.zh: 回来可别带口音。我警告你。

lines.en: No promises, y'all.
lines.zh: 不敢保证哦，各位。

quiz.q: 林点了什么样的鸡蛋？
林发现纽约人问 “How are you?” 其实是什么意思？
options: 真的想知道她过得怎样

quiz.q: 为什么在美国一般要给 20% 的小费？
options: 服务员底薪很低，靠小费

episodes.next_zh: 周一，Dana 交给你一个大项目：为一家社区图书馆做全新的形象设计。

episodes.title: The Library
episodes.scene_zh: 新项目的客户是皇后区的一家社区图书馆。馆长 Brooks 先生带你参观。

lines.en: Welcome to the Jackson Heights library. Forgive the mess. We've been meaning to repaint for about fifteen years.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到杰克逊高地图书馆。有点乱，请见谅。我们说要重新粉刷已经说了十五年了。

lines.en: It's lovely. It feels like people actually use it, which is more than you can say for some libraries.
lines.zh: 这里很好。感觉是真的有人在用，不是每个图书馆都能做到这一点。

lines.en: Oh, they use it. People here speak over a hundred and fifty languages. For a lot of them, this is the first place they come when they arrive.
lines.zh: 他们确实在用。这一带的人说一百五十多种语言。对很多人来说，这是他们刚到这里时第一个来的地方。

lines.en: Why the first place?
lines.zh: 为什么是第一个？

lines.en: Free internet, free classes, and nobody asks you for papers. It's warm, and it's quiet. That matters when everything else is new.
lines.zh: 免费上网、免费上课，没人查你的证件。这里暖和、安静。当别的一切都陌生的时候，这些很重要。

lines.en: I know that feeling. When I first moved to London, a little café did the same thing for me.
lines.zh: 我懂那种感觉。我刚到伦敦的时候，一家小咖啡馆对我也是这样的。

lines.en: Then you understand the brief better than most designers. We want people to see this place from the street and think, that's for me.
lines.zh: 那你比大多数设计师更懂我们的需求。我们希望人们在街上看到这里就会想：这是为我准备的。

lines.en: What's the budget?
lines.zh: 预算是多少？

lines.en: That's the difficult part. Let's just say it's smaller than the coffee budget at your office.
lines.zh: 这就是难办的地方了。这么说吧，比你们公司的咖啡预算还少。

lines.en: Then we'll have to be creative. Who's that girl in the corner? She's been reading the same page for ten minutes.
lines.zh: 那我们只能想办法了。角落里那个女孩是谁？她盯着同一页看了十分钟了。

lines.en: That's Ana. She arrived from Brazil a few months ago. She comes every day after school, but she hardly says a word.
lines.zh: 那是 Ana，几个月前从巴西来的。她每天放学都来，但几乎不说话。

lines.en: She reminds me of someone. Me, about two years ago.
lines.zh: 她让我想起一个人。两年前的我。

choice.q_zh: 馆长希望路人一看就觉得“这是给我的”，你问：

lines.en: Could I talk to some of the people who use it every day?
lines.zh: 我能和每天来的人聊聊吗？

lines.en: Of course. They'll have plenty of opinions, believe me.
lines.zh: 当然。相信我，他们意见多着呢。

lines.en: What do people say when they walk past?
lines.zh: 路过的人现在怎么说这里？

lines.en: Most of them think it's closed. That's the problem.
lines.zh: 大多数人以为关门了。问题就在这儿。

lines.en: Let me show you something. This is our guestbook from the nineteen-eighties.
lines.zh: 给你看样东西。这是八十年代的留言簿。

lines.en: There are so many languages. Is that Korean? And Greek?
lines.zh: 这么多种语言。这是韩语吗？还有希腊语？

lines.en: And Spanish, Urdu, Polish, Bengali. Everyone wrote the same thing. Thank you.
lines.zh: 还有西班牙语、乌尔都语、波兰语、孟加拉语。大家写的都是同一句：谢谢。

lines.en: That's the design. Right there, in this book.
lines.zh: 设计就在这里，就在这本留言簿里。

lines.en: Forty years, and nobody thought to put it on the wall.
lines.zh: 四十年了，从没人想过把它搬到墙上。

quiz.q: 为什么很多新移民来到这里先去图书馆？
options: 免费上网上课、不查证件、温暖安静

quiz.q: 馆长希望新形象达到什么效果？
options: 让人在街上看到就觉得“这是给我的”

quiz.q: 关于 Ana，哪一项正确？
options: 她几个月前从巴西来，几乎不说话

episodes.next_zh: 预算少得可怜。而那个总坐在角落里看书的女孩，你总觉得在哪儿见过她的眼神。

episodes.title: Small Budget, Big Idea
episodes.scene_zh: 回到公司，你向 Dana 和 Marcus 汇报图书馆项目。预算实在太少了。

lines.en: So, how bad is the budget? Give it to me straight.
lines.zh: 预算到底有多糟？直说吧。

lines.en: It's tiny. If we design it the usual way, we can afford a new sign and maybe some paint.
lines.zh: 非常少。按常规方式做，只够做一块新招牌，也许再加点油漆。

lines.en: So we're talking a logo and a prayer.
lines.zh: 也就是说，一个标志加一句祈祷。

lines.en: Not necessarily. What if the community designs it with us? The library is used by people who speak over a hundred languages.
lines.zh: 不一定。如果让社区和我们一起设计呢？用这个图书馆的人说一百多种语言。

lines.en: Go on. I'm listening.
lines.zh: 继续说，我在听。

lines.en: We ask people to write one word, in their own language, that means 'welcome' or 'home' to them. Then we paint those words across the front of the building.
lines.zh: 我们请大家用自己的语言写一个对他们来说意味着“欢迎”或“家”的词，然后把这些词画满整个大楼正面。

lines.en: Okay, that's actually kind of brilliant. And the paint's cheap.
lines.zh: 好吧，这其实挺妙的。而且油漆便宜。

lines.en: I love it, but I can see a problem. The building belongs to the city. Any change to the outside has to be approved at a public meeting.
lines.zh: 我很喜欢，但我看到一个问题。大楼归市政府所有，外观的任何改动都要在公开会议上通过。

lines.en: A public meeting. With an audience?
lines.zh: 公开会议？有观众的那种？

lines.en: A town hall. Usually a few hundred people, a microphone, and at least one person who's angry about everything.
lines.zh: 市民大会。通常几百人、一个麦克风，至少一个对什么都不满的人。

lines.en: And who presents the idea?
lines.zh: 那谁来介绍这个方案？

lines.en: It's your idea, Lin. You present it. I'll be in the front row.
lines.zh: 这是你的点子，林。你来讲，我坐第一排。

choice.q_zh: Marcus 觉得点子不错，你补充：

options.label_zh: 办工作坊让孩子一起画

lines.en: We could even run workshops so local kids can help paint.
lines.zh: 我们还可以办工作坊，让附近的孩子一起来画。

lines.en: Free labour and happy parents. I'm in.
lines.zh: 免费劳动力加开心的家长。算我一个。

lines.en: The hardest part will be deciding which words go where.
lines.zh: 最难的是决定哪个词画在哪儿。

lines.en: Easy. Let the community vote on that too.
lines.zh: 简单，也让社区投票。

bonus.title_zh: Dana 的第一次市民大会

lines.en: Want to know about my first town hall? It was a disaster.
lines.zh: 想听我第一次开市民大会的事吗？简直是灾难。

lines.en: Now I definitely want to know.
lines.zh: 那我必须得听了。

lines.en: The microphone died, a pigeon flew in, and I called the mayor by the wrong name.
lines.zh: 话筒坏了，飞进来一只鸽子，我还叫错了市长的名字。

lines.en: And did your project get approved?
lines.zh: 那你的项目通过了吗？

lines.en: Unanimously. People forgive a lot when you're honest. Just keep the pigeons out.
lines.zh: 全票通过。只要你真诚，人们能原谅很多事。只要别让鸽子进来。

quiz.q: 按常规方式，预算只够做什么？
options: 一块招牌，也许再加点油漆

quiz.q: 林的点子是什么？
options: 让社区居民用自己的语言写“欢迎”或“家”，画在大楼正面

quiz.q: 为什么方案要在公开会议上通过？

episodes.next_zh: 方案要在社区听证会上公开介绍。三百个人，一个麦克风。

episodes.title: Town Hall
episodes.scene_zh: 社区市民大会。台下坐满了人，你站在麦克风前。

lines.en: Our next speaker is Lin, from the design team working on the library. Lin, the floor is yours.
lines.zh: 下一位发言的是林，来自负责图书馆项目的设计团队。林，请。

lines.en: Thank you. I'd like to start with a question. What was the first word you learned in English?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我想先问一个问题：你学会的第一个英语单词是什么？

lines.en: Mine was 'sorry'. I said it about fifty times on my first day in London.
lines.zh: 我的是“sorry”。我在伦敦的第一天说了大概五十遍。

lines.en: Our idea is simple. We want to cover the front of the library with your words, in your languages, for 'welcome' and 'home'.
lines.zh: 我们的想法很简单：用你们的语言，把你们心中表示“欢迎”和“家”的词，画满图书馆的正面。

lines.en: Thank you, Lin. Are there any questions? Yes, the gentleman at the back.
lines.zh: 谢谢林。有问题吗？好，后排那位先生。

lines.en: Playing devil's advocate here, but isn't this just decoration? People need books and computers, not paint.
lines.zh: 我来唱个反调：这不就是装饰吗？大家需要的是书和电脑，不是油漆。

lines.en: That's a fair point, and I'd be worried too if this money came out of the book budget. It doesn't.
lines.zh: 这个问题提得有道理，如果这笔钱是从买书的预算里出的，我也会担心。但不是。

lines.en: But I'd also argue that a building has to invite you in before its books can help you. A lot of people walk past this library every day without realising it's for them.
lines.zh: 而且我想说，一栋楼得先请你进门，里面的书才帮得上你。很多人每天路过这家图书馆，却没意识到它是为他们开的。

lines.en: Shall we take a vote? All those in favour?
lines.zh: 那我们表决吧？赞成的请举手？

lines.en: That's a lot of hands. Lin, I think you just won over a room full of New Yorkers.
lines.zh: 好多手。林，我觉得你刚刚说服了一屋子纽约人。

lines.en: Was that Marcus asking the difficult question?
lines.zh: 刚才提尖锐问题的是 Marcus 吗？

lines.en: Of course. Every town hall needs someone to disagree. We just made sure it was a friendly one.
lines.zh: 当然。每场市民大会都需要有人唱反调，我们只是确保那个人是自己人。

choice.q_zh: Marcus 故意唱反调，你先回应：

lines.en: Thank you for asking. I was hoping somebody would.
lines.zh: 谢谢你问这个。我正希望有人问。

lines.en: Happy to help. I'm a professional pain in the neck.
lines.zh: 乐意效劳。我是专业讨人嫌的。

lines.en: Can I answer with a story?
lines.zh: 我能用一个故事来回答吗？

lines.en: Sure, as long as it's shorter than this meeting.
lines.zh: 可以，只要比这个会短。

lines.en: I counted. Three hundred and twelve hands in favour. Four against.
lines.zh: 我数了。三百一十二票赞成，四票反对。

lines.en: Only four? I was expecting a fight.
lines.zh: 才四票？我还以为要吵一架。

lines.en: Two of them were my brothers. They vote against everything I do.
lines.zh: 其中两个是我兄弟。我干什么他们都反对。

lines.en: Then it was practically unanimous.
lines.zh: 那几乎就是全票通过了。

lines.en: Practically. Now the hard part starts. We need a hundred languages by spring.
lines.zh: 差不多。难的才开始。春天前要凑齐一百种语言。

quiz.q: 林演讲开头问了大家什么？
options: 你学会的第一个英语单词是什么

quiz.q: 面对“这只是装饰”的质疑，林怎么回答？
options: 钱不是从买书预算里出的，而且楼要先吸引人进门

quiz.q: 提出尖锐问题的人其实是谁？

episodes.next_zh: 会后，人都散了。那个总是不说话的女孩，却朝你走了过来。

episodes.title: Ana
episodes.scene_zh: 大会散场后，Ana 鼓起勇气走到你面前。

lines.en: Excuse me. Sorry. You said your first word was 'sorry'. Mine too.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，对不起。你说你的第一个词是 sorry。我也是。

lines.en: Hi! You're Ana, aren't you? I've seen you reading in the corner.
lines.zh: 嗨！你是 Ana 吧？我见过你在角落看书。

lines.en: Yes. I read a lot. But I don't speak. When I speak, people say 'what?' and I feel stupid.
lines.zh: 是的。我读很多书，但我不说话。我一说话，别人就说“什么？”，我就觉得自己很笨。

lines.en: Can I tell you a secret? In London, I once asked for a 'bag of chips' and the man gave me crisps. I was too embarrassed to correct him.
lines.zh: 我能告诉你一个秘密吗？在伦敦，我有一次要“一袋 chips”，那人给了我薯片。我不好意思纠正他。

lines.en: Really? But your English is perfect.
lines.zh: 真的吗？可你的英语很完美。

lines.en: It isn't perfect. It's just practised. There's a big difference.
lines.zh: 不是完美，只是练得多。这差别可大了。

lines.en: How did you practise? Nobody talks to me except my teachers.
lines.zh: 你怎么练的？除了老师，没人跟我说话。

lines.en: I practised a little every day. I read sentences out loud, I talked to shopkeepers, and I made a lot of mistakes in front of very kind people.
lines.zh: 我每天练一点。把句子大声读出来，跟店主聊天，在很友善的人面前犯了很多错。

lines.en: I don't know any kind people here yet.
lines.zh: 我在这里还不认识什么友善的人。

lines.en: You know Mr Brooks. And now you know me. How about this? Every Thursday after school, we talk for half an hour. In English, with mistakes allowed.
lines.zh: 你认识 Brooks 先生，现在也认识我了。这样吧：每周四放学后，我们聊半小时。说英语，允许犯错。

lines.en: Mistakes allowed? Okay. I can do mistakes.
lines.zh: 允许犯错？好。犯错我会。

lines.en: Then you're already ahead of where I was. See you on Thursday.
lines.zh: 那你已经比当年的我强了。周四见。

choice.q_zh: Ana 很没信心，你想鼓励她：

lines.en: Everyone sounds strange in a new language at first.
lines.zh: 刚开始说一门新语言，谁听起来都怪怪的。

lines.en: Even in Portuguese, I sound strange sometimes.
lines.zh: 我说葡萄牙语有时候都怪怪的。

lines.en: Would you like to try now? Just one sentence.
lines.zh: 要不现在试一句？就一句。

lines.en: Okay. My name is Ana, and I like books with dragons.
lines.zh: 好。我叫 Ana，我喜欢有龙的书。

lines.en: So, tell me about your home in Brazil.
lines.zh: 跟我说说你在巴西的家吧。

lines.en: I lived with my grandmother in Recife. Near the sea. She makes the best cake in the world.
lines.zh: 我和奶奶住在累西腓，靠海。她做的蛋糕是世界上最好吃的。

lines.en: What kind of cake?
lines.zh: 什么蛋糕？

lines.en: Bolo de rolo. It's very thin, and it rolls. I don't know the English word.
lines.zh: 卷卷蛋糕。很薄，卷起来的。我不知道英语怎么说。

lines.en: Neither do I. Maybe there isn't one. That's the best kind of word.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。也许英语里根本没有。这种词最好了。

quiz.q: Ana 为什么不敢说英语？
options: 别人一说“什么？”她就觉得自己笨

quiz.q: 林说她的英语为什么好？
林和 Ana 约定了什么？
options: 每周四放学后用英语聊半小时，允许犯错
让 Ana 来公司实习

episodes.next_zh: 开幕前一周，Emma 打来视频电话：她要来纽约了。

episodes.title: Visitors
episodes.scene_zh: Emma 从伦敦飞来看你，正好赶上图书馆的开幕。Jake 坚持要亲自带她逛纽约。

lines.en: Lin! I can't believe I'm actually here. Everything is so big. Even the coffee.
lines.zh: 林！我真不敢相信我来了。什么都好大，连咖啡都是。

lines.en: You must be the famous Emma. Lin talks about you constantly.
lines.zh: 你一定就是大名鼎鼎的 Emma。林总提起你。

lines.en: Only good things, I hope. You must be Jake, the man who stole my flatmate.
lines.zh: 希望都是好话。你一定是 Jake，抢走我室友的人。

lines.en: Guilty. Though in my defence, Lin chose to come.
lines.zh: 认罪。不过替自己辩解一句，是林自己选择来的。

lines.en: Be nice, both of you. Emma, how's Arthur? And the Blue Door?
lines.zh: 你们俩客气点。Emma，Arthur 怎么样？蓝门呢？

lines.en: Busier than ever. He's started a Thursday conversation night. He says he got the idea from you.
lines.zh: 比以前还忙。他办了个周四会话之夜，说是从你那儿学来的点子。

lines.en: That's funny. I've just started Thursday conversations with a girl here. Her name's Ana.
lines.zh: 真巧。我刚在这里和一个女孩开始了周四对话，她叫 Ana。

lines.en: The next person? From the notebook?
lines.zh: 下一个人？笔记本里说的那个？

lines.en: Maybe. I haven't given it to her yet. I want to wait for the right moment.
lines.zh: 也许吧。我还没给她，想等一个合适的时机。

lines.en: Speaking of moments, Lin, I need to ask you something. The studio wants you to stay another year. Dana's already written the offer.
lines.zh: 说到时机，林，我有件事要问你。公司希望你再留一年，Dana 已经把聘书写好了。

lines.en: Another year? Lin, you don't have to decide now.
lines.zh: 再留一年？林，你不用现在就决定。

lines.en: I know. Let's get through the opening first. Then I'll think about the rest.
lines.zh: 我知道。先把开幕办完，其他的之后再想。

lines.en: And have you finished the novel yet?
lines.zh: 小说写完了吗？

lines.en: Two chapters to go. You'll be the first to read it.
lines.zh: 还剩两章。你会是第一个读的。

options.label_zh: Tom 和 Patel 太太还好吗

lines.en: And are Tom and Mrs Patel behaving?
lines.zh: Tom 和 Patel 太太还老实吗？

lines.en: Tom isn't. Mrs Patel is running the whole street, as usual.
lines.zh: Tom 不老实。Patel 太太还是照样管着整条街。

lines.en: So, Emma, after one whole day, what do you think of New York?
lines.zh: 那么 Emma，待了一整天，你觉得纽约怎么样？

lines.en: Honestly? Not bad.
lines.zh: 说实话？还不赖。

lines.en: Not bad? That's it? I showed you the best pizza in the city!
lines.zh: 还不赖？就这？我带你吃了全城最好的披萨！

lines.en: Jake, in Britain, "not bad" means it was really good.
lines.zh: Jake，在英国，“还不赖”就是“真的很好”。

lines.en: You people are impossible. Wonderful, but impossible.
lines.zh: 你们这些人真没法搞。很棒，但是没法搞。

quiz.q: Arthur 在伦敦办了什么新活动？
林为什么还没把笔记本给 Ana？
Jake 带来了什么消息？

episodes.next_zh: 开幕那天，Ana 要站到台上，用英语读一段她自己写的文字。

episodes.title: For the Next Person
episodes.scene_zh: 图书馆开幕。正面墙上画满了一百多种语言的“欢迎”和“家”。Ana 走上了台。

lines.en: Welcome, everyone, to the new Jackson Heights library. Before we cut the ribbon, a young reader would like to say a few words.
lines.zh: 欢迎大家来到焕然一新的杰克逊高地图书馆。剪彩之前，一位年轻的读者想说几句话。

lines.en: Hello. My name is Ana. I am fourteen, and I came from Brazil seven months ago.
lines.zh: 大家好，我叫 Ana，十四岁，七个月前从巴西来。

lines.en: When I arrived, I did not speak. Not because I had no words, but because I was afraid of the wrong ones.
lines.zh: 刚来的时候，我不说话。不是因为我没有词，而是因为我怕说错。

lines.en: Every Thursday, a friend told me that mistakes are allowed. So today I am making mistakes in front of all of you.
lines.zh: 每个星期四，一个朋友告诉我：可以犯错。所以今天，我在你们所有人面前犯错。

lines.en: The word I wrote on the wall is 'casa'. It means home. This library was my first one here.
lines.zh: 我写在墙上的词是 casa，意思是家。这座图书馆是我在这里的第一个家。

lines.en: Lin, are you crying?
lines.zh: 林，你在哭吗？

lines.en: Absolutely not. It's the paint. My eyes are sensitive to paint.
lines.zh: 绝对没有。是油漆。我的眼睛对油漆过敏。

lines.en: Ana, that was wonderful. I have something for you. It was given to me by someone in Edinburgh.
lines.zh: Ana，你讲得太好了。我有样东西给你。这是爱丁堡的一个人给我的。

lines.en: A notebook? There's writing on the first page. 'For the next person, who needs it more than I do.'
lines.zh: 一本笔记本？第一页写着字：“给下一个人，他比我更需要它。”

lines.en: Fill it with your mistakes and your new words. And one day, when you meet someone who's afraid to speak, you'll know what to do with it.
lines.zh: 把你的错误和新学的词都写进去。有一天，当你遇到一个不敢开口的人，你就知道该怎么做了。

lines.en: So, Lin. The offer. Have you decided?
lines.zh: 那么，林，聘书的事，你决定了吗？

lines.en: I have. I'll stay another year. I've got a Thursday appointment I'm not ready to give up.
lines.zh: 决定了。我再留一年。我有个周四的约，还不想放弃。

choice.q_zh: Ana 读出了第一页的那句话，你说：

options.label_zh: 葡萄牙语也可以写进去

lines.en: You can write in Portuguese too. Both languages belong in there.
lines.zh: 你也可以写葡萄牙语。两种语言都属于这本笔记本。

lines.en: Then the first word will be "obrigada". Thank you.
lines.zh: 那第一个词就写“obrigada”，谢谢。

options.label_zh: 勇敢的时候读最后一页

lines.en: Read the last page when you feel brave.
lines.zh: 觉得勇敢的时候，读读最后一页。

lines.en: I'll read it tonight. I feel brave today.
lines.zh: 我今晚就读。我今天很勇敢。

lines.en: Dear Sophie, the notebook has found its next person.
lines.zh: 亲爱的 Sophie，笔记本找到下一个人了。

lines.en: Her name is Ana. She's fourteen, she loves dragons, and today she spoke in front of three hundred people.
lines.zh: 她叫 Ana，十四岁，喜欢龙，今天她在三百个人面前讲了话。

lines.en: I painted a little of Rose's blue on the library door. Arthur would approve.
lines.zh: 我在图书馆的门上刷了一点 Rose 的蓝色。Arthur 一定会赞成。

lines.en: Thank you for the note that started everything. I still have it. I always will.
lines.zh: 谢谢你那张让一切开始的纸条。我还留着，会一直留着。

lines.en: Love from New York, Lin. P.S. Save me a seat at the long table.
lines.zh: 来自纽约的爱，林。附：长桌边给我留个位子。

quiz.q: Ana 写在墙上的词是什么意思？
林把什么交给了 Ana？
options: 那本写着“给下一个人”的笔记本

quiz.q: 林最后的决定是什么？

episodes.next_zh: 第四季完。新的剧集会继续更新。
